zh: function decide(s, p, st)   必须有。每个回合调用一次，返回一个数。
en: function decide(s, p, st)   Required. Called once per round; returns a number.

zh: 返回这一回合的出价。不大于 0，或者返回的不是数 = 这一回合不出价。出价最高的买走；买到的人赚 V − 付的钱。
en: Returns this round's bid. A value not above 0, or anything that is not a number = no bid this round. The highest bid buys; the buyer earns V − the amount paid.

zh: 返回这一回合的半价差 h（负数按 0 算；不是数 = 这一回合不报价）。等于同时挂出卖价 s.x + h 和买价 s.x − h。
en: Returns this round's half-spread h (a negative number counts as 0; not a number = no quote this round). This amounts to posting an ask of s.x + h and a bid of s.x − h at the same time.

zh: function init(p)            可以没有。每一场开始时调用一次，返回的对象就是 decide 的第三个参数 st。
en: function init(p)            Optional. Called once at the start of each match; the object it returns is decide's third argument st.

zh: s.x        这一回合你对真实价值 V 的估计：V 加上 −ε 到 +ε 之间均匀分布的误差。各条规则的误差互相独立
en: s.x        Your estimate of the true value V this round: V plus an error uniformly distributed between −ε and +ε. The errors of different rules are independent

zh: s.n        场上一共几条规则
en: s.n        Number of rules in the market

zh: s.t  s.T   这是第几回合（从 0 起）、一场一共几回合
en: s.t  s.T   Index of this round (from 0), number of rounds in a match

zh: s.g        市场的常数：s.g.lo、s.g.hi（V 在这之间均匀分布）、s.g.eps（ε）§0§
en: s.g        The market's constants: s.g.lo, s.g.hi (V is uniform between them), s.g.eps (ε)§0§

zh: 、s.g.fmt（"first" 付自己的出价，"second" 付第二高的出价）
en: , s.g.fmt ("first": pay your own bid; "second": pay the second-highest bid)

zh: 、s.g.pi（客人是知情的概率）、s.g.R（不知情的客人能接受报价离 V 多远）
en: , s.g.pi (probability that the customer is informed), s.g.R (how far from V a quote can be for an uninformed customer to accept it)

zh: s.last     上一回合你的盈亏（没成交是 0，第一回合是 NaN）；s.lastA 是上一回合你报的数；s.won 是上一回合你成交了没有（1 / 0）
en: s.last     Your P&L in the previous round (0 if you did not trade, NaN in the first round); s.lastA is the number you returned in the previous round; s.won is whether you traded in the previous round (1 / 0)

zh: s.v        上一回合的真实价值（每回合结束后公布）；s.win 是上一回合的成交价（没成交是 NaN）§0§
en: s.v        The true value in the previous round (announced after each round); s.win is the previous round's trade price (NaN if there was no trade)§0§

zh: ；s.side 是上一回合客人买（1）、卖（−1）还是没成交（0）
en: ; s.side is whether the customer bought (1), sold (−1) or did not trade (0) in the previous round

zh: s.total    到目前为止你的累计盈亏；s.rnd() 给一个 0 到 1 之间的均匀随机数
en: s.total    Your cumulative P&L so far; s.rnd() gives a uniform random number between 0 and 1

zh: p          你在"参数"一栏里写的那些数（只读）
en: p          The numbers you wrote in the "Parameters" field (read-only)

zh: 请替我写一条规则，用在一个模拟市场里和别的规则同场竞争。只回一段 JavaScript 代码，不要解释。
en: Please write a rule for me, to compete against other rules in a simulated market. Reply with one block of JavaScript code only, without explanation.

zh: 市场：共同价值拍卖。每一回合有一件东西，真实价值 V 在 [lo, hi] 上均匀分布，谁也看不到。每条规则各自看到一个带误差的估计 x = V + U(−ε, ε)，然后各出一个价；出价最高的买走，赚 V − 付的钱。每回合结束后公布 V 和成交价。得分是平均每回合的盈亏。
en: Market: a common-value auction. In each round there is one item whose true value V is uniformly distributed on [lo, hi] and which nobody can see. Each rule sees its own noisy estimate x = V + U(−ε, ε) and then submits a bid; the highest bid buys the item and earns V − the amount paid. V and the trade price are announced after each round. The score is the average P&L per round.

zh: 市场：几条规则同时做市。每一回合有一件东西，真实价值 V 在 [lo, hi] 上均匀分布，谁也看不到。每条规则各自看到一个带误差的估计 x = V + U(−ε, ε)，然后各报一个半价差 h，等于挂出卖价 x + h 和买价 x − h。来一位客人：不知情的随机买或卖，在最好的报价上成交；知情的知道 V，只在有便宜可占时出手。成交的规则：卖出赚 卖价 − V，买进赚 V − 买价。每回合结束后公布 V 和成交价。得分是平均每回合的盈亏。
en: Market: several rules make a market at the same time. In each round there is one item whose true value V is uniformly distributed on [lo, hi] and which nobody can see. Each rule sees its own noisy estimate x = V + U(−ε, ε) and then quotes a half-spread h, which amounts to posting an ask of x + h and a bid of x − h. One customer arrives: an uninformed customer buys or sells at random and trades at the best quote; an informed customer knows V and trades only when there is a profit to be had. The rule that trades earns ask − V on a sale and V − bid on a purchase. V and the trade price are announced after each round. The score is the average P&L per round.

zh: 要求：只定义 decide（需要的话加 init），不要有别的顶层语句；不要用 eval、不要联网；参数都从 p 里读。
en: Requirements: define only decide (plus init if needed), with no other top-level statements; do not use eval and do not access the network; read every parameter from p.

zh: 别处的规则都是各打各的；这里把几条规则放进同一个市场，互相当对手。一条规则赚多少，取决于别的规则怎么出手。
en: Elsewhere each rule plays on its own; here several rules are put into the same market as each other's opponents. How much a rule earns depends on what the other rules do.

zh: 竞价：每一回合有一件东西，真实价值 V 谁也看不到，每条规则各自看到一个带误差的估计，然后各出一个价。出价最高的买走，赚 V 减去付的钱。出价最高的人，手里往往是最乐观的那个估计，这就是赢家诅咒。
en: Auction: in each round there is one item whose true value V nobody can see; each rule sees its own noisy estimate and then submits a bid. The highest bid buys the item and earns V minus the amount paid. The highest bidder tends to be the one holding the most optimistic estimate; this is the winner's curse.

zh: 做市：每条规则报一个半价差，等于同时挂出卖价和买价。来一位客人，在最好的那个报价上成交。价差小才抢得到单，可是抢到的多半是自己估错的那些；知情的客人更是只在你报错价时才来。
en: Market making: each rule quotes a half-spread, which amounts to posting an ask and a bid at the same time. One customer arrives and trades at the best quote. Only a narrow spread wins the trade, but the trades it wins are mostly the ones where your estimate was off; and informed customers come only when your quote is wrong.
